g.text: Longer response time is associated with higher accuracy, but the gains flatten near the accuracy ceiling.
Pearson r (log time) = 0.80 | rank correlation rho = 0.78 | bounded-curve R-squared = 0.78

g.text: HOW TO READ: right of zero = more accurate than expected; left of zero = less accurate than expected. Rings mark the 3 largest gaps.
Common panel: 60 exercises (33 Analysis 3, 27 Physics 2), 14 models, 840 macro-averaged cells
